definitions.gloss: no-confidence motion; motion of no confidence
definitions.explanation: A motion put before a legislature declaring that it no longer has confidence in the cabinet, a minister or a leader. In Japan, if the House of Representatives passes one against the cabinet, the cabinet must resign or dissolve the House within ten days.

examples.japanese: {不信任案|ふしんにんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
{内閣不信任案|ないかくふしんにんあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The motion of no confidence in the cabinet was voted down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会期末|かいきまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧、⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{不信任案|ふしんにんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{構|かま}え→構え：27148_kamae⟧だ。
examples.english: The opposition is preparing to table a no-confidence motion against the prime minister at the end of the session.

notes:
Short for {不信任決議案|ふしんにんけつぎあん}: ⟦{不信任|ふしんにん}→不信任：32115_fushinnin⟧ (no confidence) + ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (proposal, bill).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内閣不信任案|ないかくふしんにんあん}: no-confidence motion against the cabinet
- {不信任案|ふしんにんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a no-confidence motion
